svg.aria-label: Operating model. People direct and own: direction, architecture, priorities, decisions and accountability. AI accelerates execution; technology makes it possible; business defines what matters. Governance runs throughout: documented rules, controlled access, protected information, human approvals, testing, independent verification, audit records, monitored operations.
